Class ResourceColors

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.paper.ResourceColors
public final class ResourceColors extends Object
The color of resources in menus (the storage_<id>_color placeholders), as 0xRRGGBB: tinted fill bars take it, e.g. through zMenu's dyed-color component. A resource's color is its type's ResourceType.color(); colorers color types by rule for the ones without one. Without a color, white (the bar's own texture).

Order: the type's color, then the colorers in registration order, then white.
